title: My Sister-In-Law Forged A Deed To Steal My Camp. So I Sent Profit Statements To Prison.
description: After my brother died, his widow forged a quitclaim deed to steal my half of the remote fishing camp he left us. I proved the forgery, the court voided the sale, and now I own it outright. Now I run 'Reel Justice Lodge' and mail her profit statements in prison every quarter. #InheritanceFraud #ReelJustice #FamilyBetrayal
thumb_text: SHE STOLE MY CAMP, NOW GETS PROFIT STATEMENTS IN PRISON
pinned_comment: If your sister-in-law forged a quitclaim deed for $1 to steal your half of a remote fishing camp, would you mail her profit statements every quarter too? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: SHE SOLD THE CAMP AND WENT TO PRISON FOR FRAUD
